title: Claude Code Product Lead Cat Wu Abruptly Jumps Ship; Three Core Members Leave in Succession Within Two Weeks
excerpt: The battle for top talent in the AI race is only intensifying. According to the latest industry updates, Cat Wu, former product lead for Claude Code, announced
content_html:
The battle for top talent in the AI race is only intensifying. According to the latest industry updates, Cat Wu, former product lead for Claude Code, announced she was leaving Anthropic and just one day later officially announced she was joining competitor OpenAI — a seamless, lightning-fast move.

Core Product Management and a Warm Welcome from Leadership

After joining OpenAI, Cat Wu will mainly be responsible for product management of core products and will work closely with Tibo, who oversees the related business. OpenAI President Greg Brockman also posted a message specifically to offer a warm welcome after her high-profile addition.

Core Team Hit by Wave of Departures Within Two Weeks

Notably, Cat Wu’s departure is not an isolated incident, but rather a microcosm of a recent wave of talent changes facing Anthropic’s core product, Claude Code.

In just the past two weeks, the Claude Code team has now seen a third key member leave. Just ten days ago, two other engineers deeply involved in developing Claude Code’s core features also announced their departures in succession: one was Thariq Shihipar, who worked on Agent features, Skills, and context engineering; the other was Anthony Morris, who built the Claude Code desktop version. This wave of departures among key core team members has also drawn sustained outside attention to talent mobility and the competitive landscape among frontier AI teams.
